description: Get the minimum and maximum amount for one route, in the asset you send. Call it before get_quote or create_swap: an amount outside the limits is refused by both. For the estimate itself use get_quote. With mode=private the swap runs as two legs through an intermediate coin and the limits cover both legs. Limits are read live and can change between calls.

from.description: asset slug you send, from list_assets, e.g. usdt-trc20

mode.description: standard (default), or private: the swap runs as two legs at two providers through an intermediate coin; the limits then cover both legs

rateType.description: floating (default): an estimate settled when the deposit confirms; fixed: a held amount under a rateId for about a minute to create the swap with, then the order's own deposit deadline (payTill)

to.description: asset slug you receive, e.g. btc

via.description: private mode only: slug of the intermediate coin; omitted → the server picks among sol, trx, ltc; xmr on request (Untraceable mode: the hop runs on Monero)

name: get_limits
title: Minimum and maximum
